_instructions: Session task list texts. snapshot_heading opens the list in the instructions ({revision} is the list's revision when the snapshot was made); snapshot_rule follows it; snapshot_empty replaces the sections when there are none. step_line opens the one-line task state in each step's guidance message ({sections} lists each open section and its active step). Edited in place; no compile.
snapshot_heading: Session tasks: this session's working list, as of revision {revision}; it ends with the session. Track each multi-step piece of work in it with task_list_write as you go; read it with task_list_read.
snapshot_rule: If another session or a later day would need something, it belongs in Main Notes; a step of the work in front of you belongs here.
